name: How long does a home remodeling project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a home remodeling project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a home remodeling project depends heavily on its complexity and size. Smaller projects, like a single bathroom refresh, might take 3-6 weeks. A kitchen remodel typically requires 6-12 weeks, while a major whole-home renovation or addition could extend from 4 months to over a year. Factors such as permitting, material lead times, unforeseen structural issues, and homeowner decision-making can all impact the timeline. Your contractor can provide a more accurate schedule after assessing the project details.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary: 3-6 weeks for small remodels, 6-12 weeks for kitchens, and 4 months to over a year for whole-home renovations.
